purpose: Version 87 is a reproducible mainline candidate for direct K-1 II qualification. It carries the libgphoto2 main branch after version 86 and the patcher main branch after the version 86 artifact; it is intended to prove the clean build, publication, deployment, and post-boot identity path before controlled K-1 II testing.

changes.summary: Build the current libgphoto2 main branch, including the merged IMAGE Transmitter 2 format-domain separation and K-1/K-1 II live-view start changes. The open focus audit branch is deliberately not included in this candidate.
Build from patcher main, including the merged Stage-2 empty-choice guard and the release identity, manifest, differential, and verified extracted-tree install process.

validation_focus: Verify post-boot FwVer, build_id, source commits, ZIP digest, install-manifest digest, and mandatory installed-file hashes.
Confirm the running device is the K-1 II before camera operations.
Record the standard K-1 II controls and their advertised values, including image format, shutter speeds, ISO, AF With Live View, focus controls, preview/live view, and capture.
Use one controlled variable at a time, capture the direct libgphoto2/Polaris logs, and restore every changed camera setting.
Treat successful deployment and library responses as separate from physical camera qualification; record any crash, timeout, stale widget, or client failure as a separate result.
known_limits: This candidate does not claim K-3 III Monochrome qualification.
The focus-direction and AF-release changes from PR #137 are not included because that branch is not merged to libgphoto2 main.
A successful K-1 II run covers only the recorded scenarios and does not qualify every Pentax model or every capture mode.
